About me

Turning HR Data
into Business Value

I am a People Analytics Manager and project leader with over 15 years of international experience in HR, HRIS, and ESG reporting. I have led cross-functional transformation programs across 60+ countries — from end-to-end system deployments and data governance frameworks to compliance initiatives and workforce strategy. My work goes beyond reporting: I drive decisions, lead change, and deliver measurable impact at the intersection of human resources, data, and technology.

Throughout my career, I have led complex social reporting campaigns, driven HRIS implementations, coordinated external audits, and managed HR data through major M&A operations — always with a strong focus on data integrity, compliance, and strategic impact.

I combine a technical mindset with a deep understanding of global HR practices, enabling me to bridge the gap between operational teams and executive decision-makers across 40+ countries.
